flavor.yaml:
# Europe lab extension of the unchanged NVIDIA v26.4 passthrough flavor.
# Native BFB NTPsec must synchronize before the agent can authenticate.
apiVersion: provisioning.dpu.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: DPUFlavor
metadata:
  name: passthrough-europe-dns-ntp-v1
  namespace: dpf-operator-system
spec:
  dpuMode: zero-trust
  grub:
    kernelParameters:
    - console=hvc0
    - console=ttyAMA0
    - earlycon=pl011,0x13010000
    - fixrttc
    - net.ifnames=0
    - biosdevname=0
    - iommu.passthrough=1
    - cgroup_no_v1=net_prio,net_cls
    - hugepagesz=2048kB
    - hugepages=3072
  nvconfig:
  - device: '*'
    parameters:
    - PF_BAR2_ENABLE=0
    - PER_PF_NUM_SF=1
    - PF_TOTAL_SF=20
    - PF_SF_BAR_SIZE=10
    - NUM_PF_MSIX_VALID=0
    - PF_NUM_PF_MSIX_VALID=1
    - PF_NUM_PF_MSIX=228
    - INTERNAL_CPU_MODEL=1
    - INTERNAL_CPU_OFFLOAD_ENGINE=0
    - SRIOV_EN=1
    - NUM_OF_VFS=46
    - LAG_RESOURCE_ALLOCATION=1
    - LINK_TYPE_P1=ETH
    - LINK_TYPE_P2=ETH
  ovs:
    rawConfigScript: |
      _ovs-vsctl() {
        ovs-vsctl --timeout 15 "$@"
      }

      # Remove default OVS configuration on the DPU and ensure no leftovers on the OVS kernel side
      _ovs-vsctl --if-exists del-br ovsbr1
      _ovs-vsctl --if-exists del-br ovsbr2
      ovs-appctl --timeout 15 dpctl/del-dp system@ovs-system || true

      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:doca-init=true
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:dpdk-max-memzones=50000
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:hw-offload=true
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:pmd-quiet-idle=true
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:max-idle=20000
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:max-revalidator=5000
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:doca-congestion-threshold=60
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:flow-limit=500000
      _ovs-vsctl set Open_vSwitch . other_config:hw-offload-ct-unidir-udp-enabled=true
      _ovs-vsctl remove Open_vSwitch . other_config default-datapath-type || true

      if systemctl list-unit-files openvswitch-switch.service &>/dev/null; then
        systemctl restart openvswitch-switch
      elif systemctl list-unit-files openvswitch.service &>/dev/null; then
        systemctl restart openvswitch
      fi
      _ovs-vsctl --may-exist add-br br-sfc
      _ovs-vsctl set bridge br-sfc datapath_type=netdev
      _ovs-vsctl set bridge br-sfc fail_mode=secure
      _ovs-vsctl --may-exist add-port br-sfc p0
      _ovs-vsctl set Interface p0 type=dpdk
      _ovs-vsctl set Interface p0 mtu_request=9216
      _ovs-vsctl set Port p0 external_ids:dpf-type=physical
  bfcfgParameters:
  - UPDATE_ATF_UEFI=yes
  - UPDATE_DPU_OS=yes
  - WITH_NIC_FW_UPDATE=yes
  configFiles:
  - path: /etc/mellanox/mlnx-bf.conf
    operation: override
    raw: |
      ALLOW_SHARED_RQ="no"
      IPSEC_FULL_OFFLOAD="no"
      ENABLE_ESWITCH_MULTIPORT="yes"
    permissions: '0644'
  - path: /etc/mellanox/mlnx-ovs.conf
    operation: override
    raw: |
      CREATE_OVS_BRIDGES="no"
      OVS_DOCA="yes"
    permissions: '0644'
  - path: /etc/mellanox/mlnx-sf.conf
    operation: override
    raw: ''
    permissions: '0644'
  - path: /etc/netplan/60-europe-lab-dns.yaml
    operation: override
    permissions: '0600'
    raw: |
      network:
        version: 2
        ethernets:
          oob_net0:
            nameservers:
              addresses: [203.0.113.53, 203.0.113.54, 203.0.113.55]
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/dpu-agent.service.d/10-time-sync.conf
    operation: override
    permissions: '0644'
    raw: |
      [Unit]
      Requires=ntpsec.service
      After=ntpsec.service

      [Service]
      ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/ntpwait -n 90 -s 2 -v
      TimeoutStartSec=240

apiVersion: svc.dpu.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: DPUServiceInterface
metadata:
  name: europe-pf0hpf
  namespace: dpf-operator-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            interface: pf0hpf
        spec:
          interfaceType: pf
          pf:
            pfID: 0
  clusterSelector:
    matchLabels:
      training.dpf.nvidia.com/tenant: europe
---
apiVersion: svc.dpu.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: DPUServiceInterface
metadata:
  name: europe-pf1hpf
  namespace: dpf-operator-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            interface: pf1hpf
        spec:
          interfaceType: pf
          pf:
            pfID: 1
  clusterSelector:
    matchLabels:
      training.dpf.nvidia.com/tenant: europe
---
apiVersion: svc.dpu.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: DPUServiceChain
metadata:
  name: europe-passthrough
  namespace: dpf-operator-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          switches:
          - ports:
            - serviceInterface:
                matchLabels:
                  interface: p0
            - serviceInterface:
                matchLabels:
                  interface: pf0hpf
            # Explicitly preserve the applied lab service MTU.
            serviceMTU: 1500
          - ports:
            - serviceInterface:
                matchLabels:
                  interface: p1
            - serviceInterface:
                matchLabels:
                  interface: pf1hpf
            serviceMTU: 1500
  clusterSelector:
    matchLabels:
      training.dpf.nvidia.com/tenant: europe

dpuset.yaml:
# Europe only: DPU SIM00000001 / BMC 192.0.2.246.
# Hardware has 16 GiB; administrator approved experimental provisioning.
# Release the Europe maintenance hold explicitly after prerequisite checks.
# BFB source: dpf-installation/lab/passthrough/10-bfb.yaml (repository root).
# Flavor source: dpuflavor-europe-dns-ntp.yaml in this directory.
# See EUROPE-YAML-GUIDE.txt for file roles and the post-install reboot gate.
apiVersion: provisioning.dpu.nvidia.com/v1alpha1
kind: DPUSet
metadata:
  name: passthrough-europe
  namespace: dpf-operator-system
spec:
  strategy:
    # Template changes do not automatically replace existing DPUs.
    type: OnDelete
  dpuNodeSelector:
    # All three labels must match: select only the approved Europe node.
    matchLabels:
      feature.node.kubernetes.io/dpu-enabled: 'true'
      training.dpf.nvidia.com/selected: 'true'
      training.dpf.nvidia.com/tenant: europe
  dpuTemplate:
    spec:
      dpuFlavor: passthrough-europe-dns-ntp-v1
      bfb:
        name: bf-bundle-v26.4.0
      nodeEffect:
        # Initial provisioning hold; already released for the October 5 retry.
        # The later physical-host reboot acknowledgement is a separate step.
        hold: true
      cluster:
        # Target the Europe DPUCluster by label, not by namespace alone.
        selector:
          matchLabels:
            training.dpf.nvidia.com/tenant: europe
  dpuDeviceSelector:
    # Select the Europe card only, even if discovery finds other DPUs.
    matchLabels:
      provisioning.dpu.nvidia.com/dpudevice-bmc-ip: 192.0.2.246
      provisioning.dpu.nvidia.com/dpunode-name: dpu-node-sim00000001
